description: ICICI Pru GIFT Pro is a protection and savings-oriented life insurance plan designed to provide financial protection to your family while helping you achieve life goals like marriage, parenthood, children's education, and retirement through guaranteed benefits. It offers extensive flexibility in choosing life cover, income options, MoneyBack benefits, and payout timings.

features.feature_description: Provides financial security to the family in case of the Life Assured's demise during the policy term.
Policyholders can choose to receive Guaranteed Income that either remains level throughout the Income Period or increases every year at a simple interest rate of 5% p.a.
Flexibility to select the duration of Guaranteed Income as per individual needs (5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30 years).
Option to choose a lump sum MoneyBack Benefit as any percentage from 0% to 200% of the sum total of all annualized premiums payable. This choice impacts the regular income amount.
Flexibility to choose any year, on or after the maturity date of the policy up to the last income year, to receive the MoneyBack Benefit.
An option at inception to receive additional Guaranteed Income for opting a lower life cover.
Allows policyholders to choose any specific date (e.g., spouse’s birthdate, anniversary) for annual Guaranteed Income payouts.

features.feature_name: Lump Sum Conversion of Future Benefits
features.feature_description: Option to receive all future Guaranteed Incomes and MoneyBack Benefit (if applicable) as a discounted lump sum at policy maturity or any time during the income period. The discount rate is based on 30-year Government Securities yield + 1.00%.
Policyholders paying higher annualized premiums receive an additional guaranteed income rate (ranging from 0% to 3.75% of Annualized Premium), which increases with higher premium thresholds.

In case of the Life Assured's death during the policy term, a lump sum Death Benefit is paid. It is the highest of four defined values, including Sum Assured on Death (based on age and Low Cover Income Booster choice), 105% of Total Premiums Paid, and Surrender Value. If death occurs during the Income Period, the claimant continues to receive Guaranteed Income and MoneyBack Benefit, or can opt for a discounted lump sum.

If premiums stop after the first policy year, the policy continues with reduced Paid-up Maturity Benefit (Paid-up GI and Paid-up MoneyBack Benefit) and Paid-up Death Benefit. No benefits are payable if premiums stop in the first policy year.
Tax benefits may be applicable on premiums paid and benefits received as per the prevailing tax laws.
The product is also available for purchase online.
No specific product exclusions (e.g., suicide clause, specific hazardous activities) are explicitly mentioned in the provided brochure text. General disclaimers about fraudulent calls are present.
